back_translation: Hear this word that I take up as a lament over you, O house of Israel:
Virgin Israel has fallen; she will rise no more. She is forsaken on her own land, with no one to raise her up.
For thus says the Lord GOD: The city that sends out a thousand will have a hundred left, and the one that sends out a hundred will have ten left, for the house of Israel.
For thus says the LORD to the house of Israel: Seek Me and live;
but do not seek Bethel, do not enter Gilgal, and do not cross over to Beersheba; for Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will come to nothing.
Seek the LORD and live, lest He break out like fire against the house of Joseph; the fire will devour Bethel, with no one to quench it.
You who turn justice bitter as wormwood and cast righteousness down to the ground—

He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns deep darkness into morning and darkens the day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out on the face of the earth—the LORD is His name.
He flashes destruction upon the strong, so that destruction comes upon the fortress.
They hate the one who reproves at the gate, and they detest the one who speaks the truth.

Therefore, because you trample the poor and exact taxes of grain from him, though you have built houses of hewn stone, you will not live in them; though you have planted pleasant vineyards, you will not drink their wine.
For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are great—you who oppress the righteous, take bribes, and turn aside the needy at the gate.
Therefore the prudent person keeps silent at such a time, for it is an evil time.
Seek good and not evil, that you may live; then the LORD God of Hosts will be with you, as you have claimed.
Hate evil and love good, and establish justice at the gate; perhaps the LORD God of Hosts will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.

Therefore the LORD God of Hosts, the Lord, says this: In all the public squares there will be wailing, and in all the streets they will say, 'Alas! Alas!' They will summon the farmer to mourning and the skilled mourners to wailing.
In all the vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through your midst, says the LORD.
Woe to you who long for the day of the LORD! What good will the day of the LORD be to you? It is darkness, not light.
It is as when a man flees from a lion and a bear meets him, or he goes into the house, rests his hand on the wall, and a serpent bites him.
Will not the day of the LORD be darkness and not light—thick gloom with no brightness in it?
I hate, I despise your festivals, and I take no delight in your solemn assemblies.
Even if you offer Me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them; and the peace offerings of your fattened animals I will not look upon.
Take away from Me the noise of your songs; I will not listen to the melody of your harps.
But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
Did you bring Me sacrifices and grain offerings in the wilderness for forty years, O house of Israel?
Instead, you carried Sikkuth your king and Kiyyun your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus, says the LORD, whose name is the God of Hosts.
